mkdir -p /workspace/vendor /workspace/tmp /workspace/diagnostics
TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps --target /workspace/vendor pillow numpy music21 pytesseract packaging > /workspace/diagnostics/install.log 2>&1
tail -20 /workspace/diagnostics/install.log
df -h / /tmp /workspace
command -v java
command -v tesseract
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
paths=sorted(Path('/workspace/inputs').glob('*.png'))
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(2100,sum(Image.open(p).height*2+40 for p in paths)),'white')
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
y=0
for p in paths:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
 print(p.name,im.size)
 draw.text((10,y+5),p.name,fill='black')
 canvas.paste(im.resize((im.width*2,im.height*2)),(0,y+30))
 y+=im.height*2+40
canvas.save('/workspace/diagnostics/pilot-montage.png')
PY
